title: FreshTab: Sourcing Fresh Data for Table-to-Text Generation Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing table-to-text generation performance on a legacy sport-heavy benchmark (LoTNLG) versus a newly generated, domain-balanced benchmark (FreshTab diverse) to demonstrate how domain imbalance inflates perceived model capabilities.

Contrasting the results of reference-free automatic metrics (TAPAS, TAPEX) with human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge to show that automatic metrics disproportionately penalize models on novel, out-of-domain data.
Analyzing Pearson correlations between LLM-as-a-judge evaluations and human annotations to determine whether evaluating models preferentially inflate the scores of their own generated outputs.
